name: bld2_sqrt_two_rec_viete_prod_gt
statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ) : 2 / Real.pi < ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2
closed: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : a 0 = 0) (hrec : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = Real.sqrt (2 + a n)) (n : ℕ), 2 / Real.pi < ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, a (i + 1) / 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_sqrt_two_rec_viete_prod: the partial product equals 1 / (2^n * sin (π / 2^(n+1))), and sin x < x for x > 0 gives 2^n * sin (π / 2^(n+1)) < π / 2.
